description: This Java class 'SchedulerUtil' provides utility methods for managing scheduling tasks within the OpenMRS platform. It includes methods for starting and shutting down the scheduler, sending error notifications via email, retrieving exception details as strings, and calculating the next execution time for a scheduled task. The class interacts with various components such as Context, SchedulerService, and global properties, and manages privileges necessary for scheduler operations.

classes.name: SchedulerUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing scheduled tasks, including startup, shutdown, error reporting, and scheduling calculations.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Initializes the scheduler service with optional override properties and sets required privileges.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the scheduler service and cleans up resources.

methods.name: sendSchedulerError
methods.description: Sends an email notification containing system info and exception details if email alerts are enabled.

methods.name: getExceptionAsString
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a string containing its stack trace.

methods.name: getNextExecution
methods.description: Calculates the next execution time for a scheduled task based on its start time and repeat interval.
